Name: Potion of Healing
Description: A vial filled with a magical red fluid that glimmers when agitated.
Usage Implications: Consuming or administering this potion restores 2d4 + 2 hit points.

Name: Bag of Holding
Description: A cloth sack that opens into a non-dimensional space, larger on the inside than the outside.
Usage Implications: Can hold up to 500 pounds or 64 cubic feet of gear while always weighing 15 pounds. Placing it inside another extradimensional space destroys both items and creates a portal to the Astral Plane.

Name: Weapon, +1
Description: A magically reinforced weapon that strikes with supernatural accuracy and force.
Usage Implications: Grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Name: Armor, +1
Description: A set of armor enchanted to deflect blows that would normally pierce its mundane counterpart.
Usage Implications: Provides a +1 bonus to AC while worn.

Name: Ring of Protection
Description: A subtle, unadorned ring that generates a minor warding field around the wearer.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement. Grants a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.

Name: Cloak of Protection
Description: A sturdy, magical cloak that seems to gently redirect harmful magic and physical blows.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement. Grants a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.

Name: Boots of Elvenkind
Description: Supple boots that muffle the sound of the wearer's footsteps.
Usage Implications: Your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface. Grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

Name: Wand of Magic Missiles
Description: A slender wand of polished wood that hums with arcane energy.
Usage Implications: Has 7 charges. Allows the user to cast Magic Missile. Recharges 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20; on a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes.

Name: Spell Scroll (1st Level)
Description: A parchment bearing magical words that allow a spellcaster to release the stored magic.
Usage Implications: Allows a caster with the spell on their class list to cast it without providing material components. The scroll is destroyed after use.

Name: Pearl of Power
Description: A perfectly smooth, luminescent pearl pulsing with raw magical essence.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement by a spellcaster. Once per day, as an action, you can use it to regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

Name: Amulet of Health
Description: A golden amulet bearing a ruby heart that pulses with life energy.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement. Sets the wearer's Constitution score to 19. Has no effect if the wearer's Constitution is already 19 or higher.

Name: Immovable Rod
Description: A flat iron rod with a small button on one end.
Usage Implications: As an action, press the button to magically lock the rod in place. It can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight and requires a DC 30 Strength check to move up to 10 feet.

Name: Winged Boots
Description: Leather boots with small, animated wings at the heels.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement. Grants a flying speed equal to your walking speed for up to 4 hours, which can be divided into smaller increments.

Name: Broom of Flying
Description: An ordinary-looking wooden broom that responds to a magical command word.
Usage Implications: Grants a flying speed of 50 feet. Can carry up to 400 pounds, but speed drops to 30 feet if carrying over 200 pounds.

Name: Clockwork Pendant
Description: A small, ticking brass pendant containing complex gears.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement. Once per day, allows the wearer to treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 before adding modifiers.

Name: Blood-Soaked Wraps
Description: Stained linen hand wraps that pulse with necrotic and healing energies.
Usage Implications: Requires Attunement by a monk or character with unarmed strikes. Unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d4 necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the wearer heals hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.
